services.name: Charter Boats:
services.desc: Belmar Marina is also the home of New Jersey’s largest party and charter boat fleet. The boats are privately owned and their prices are at the discretion of the owners. The prices vary depending on the length of time and the type of fishing. They offer special rates to groups, children and senior citizens. Food, drinks and rental rods are available on the boats. They sail 365 days a year as long as there are customers. blurb: Belmar Manutti Marina provides boat slips for various sizes with daily, weekly, monthly, and seasonal rates. It hosts New Jersey's largest party and charter boat fleet with various fishing and cruise options. The marina offers fuel, pumpout facilities, restrooms, laundry, bait & tackle shop, and a restaurant and tiki bar.
